deciding_commits_and_classifications.description: DistillationController requires normalized SourceRecords to match state.tenant_id (enforced by read_source_records_for_tenant). Fixtures omitting tenant_id silently returned 0 records. Stamped tenant_id on _normalized_source in test_l12_dist_001_transactional_distillation.py and test_l12_mfc_r4_distill_001.py, and connector metadata.tenant_id in test_e2e_source_ingest_distillation_acceptance.py and test_product_v2_source_distillation_r3.py.

deciding_commits_and_classifications.classification: registry authentication and explicit store backend
deciding_commits_and_classifications.description: Registry service requires explicit REGISTRY_STORE_BACKEND ('memory') and authenticates all write/read routes with bearer tokens. Updated _registry_service() fixture in test_l12_dist_001_transactional_distillation.py and real_registry_server fixture in test_l12_mfc_r4_distill_001.py to set REGISTRY_STORE_BACKEND=memory and DISTILLATION_REGISTRY_SERVICE_TOKEN=test-operator:operator with bearer authorization headers on test HTTP requests.

deciding_commits_and_classifications.classification: governance approval reference retirement on HTTP /advance
deciding_commits_and_classifications.description: The HTTP /advance route retired arbitrary caller-supplied approver strings and requires authoritative governance decision references. In test_l12_dist_001_transactional_distillation.py (test_real_registry_approval_before_controller_post_is_not_overwritten), pre-approved artifact state is seeded directly via in-process registry store (get_store().put(entry) with ArtifactState.APPROVED) to verify that the controller's create-if-absent tick does not overwrite approved artifacts.

deciding_commits_and_classifications.classification: distillation queue lifetime monkeypatch target update
deciding_commits_and_classifications.description: DistillationController replaced build_source_evidence_repository with read_source_records_for_tenant. In test_distillation_queue_lifetime.py, updated monkeypatch from controller.build_source_evidence_repository to controller.read_source_records_for_tenant, preserving the test verification that exactly one queue is reused across multiple ticks.
